items.source: As of version 4.4 Spring Data Elasticsearch does not use the TransportClient from Elasticsearch anymore (which itself is deprecated since Elasticsearch 7.0). This means that the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.ElasticsearchTemplate class which was deprecated since Spring Data Elasticsearch 4.0 has been removed. This was the implementation of the ElasticsearchOperations interface that was using the TransportClient. Connections to Elasticsearch must be made using either the imperative ElasticsearchRestTemplate or the reactive ReactiveElasticsearchTemplate.
items.translation: 从版本 4.4 开始，Spring Data Elasticsearch 不再使用 Elasticsearch 的 `TransportClient`（该组件自 Elasticsearch 7.0 起已被弃用）。这意味着自 Spring Data Elasticsearch 4.0 起已被弃用的 `org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.ElasticsearchTemplate` 类已被移除。该类曾是实现 `ElasticsearchOperations` 接口的方案，且使用了 `TransportClient`。现在必须使用命令式的 `ElasticsearchRestTemplate` 或响应式的 `ReactiveElasticsearchTemplate` 来建立与 Elasticsearch 的连接。

items.source: In 4.3 two classes (ElasticsearchAggregations and ElasticsearchAggregation) had been moved to the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.clients.elasticsearch7 package in preparation for the integration of the new Elasticsearch client. The were moved back to the org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core package as we keep the classes use the old Elasticsearch client where they were.
items.translation: 在 4.3 版本中，两个类（ElasticsearchAggregations 和 ElasticsearchAggregation）曾被移至 org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core.clients.elasticsearch7 包，以准备集成新的 Elasticsearch 客户端。 由于这些类仍在使用旧版 Elasticsearch 客户端，因此它们被移回了 org.springframework.data.elasticsearch.core 包。

items.source: an ElasticsearchOperations bean, available with the bean names elasticsearchOperations and elasticsearchTemplate, this uses the ElasticsearchClient
items.translation: 一个名为 elasticsearchOperations 和 elasticsearchTemplate 的 ElasticsearchOperations Bean，它使用 ElasticsearchClient。

items.source: an ReactiveElasticsearchOperations bean, available with the bean names reactiveElasticsearchOperations and reactiveElasticsearchTemplate, this uses the ReactiveElasticsearchClient
items.translation: 一个名为 reactiveElasticsearchOperations 和 reactiveElasticsearchTemplate 的 ReactiveElasticsearchOperations Bean，它使用 ReactiveElasticsearchClient。

items.source: The ReactiveElasticsearchTemplate, when created directly or by Spring Boot configuration had a default refresh policy of IMMEDIATE. This could cause performance issues on heavy indexing and was different than the default behaviour of Elasticsearch. This has been changed to that now the default refresh policy is NONE. When the ReactiveElasticsearchTemplate was provided by using the configuration like described in Reactive REST Client the default refresh policy already was set to NONE.
items.translation: ReactiveElasticsearchTemplate 在直接创建或通过 Spring Boot 配置创建时，其默认的刷新策略为 IMMEDIATE。这会导致在高负载索引场景下出现性能问题，且与 Elasticsearch 的默认行为不一致。现已将该默认刷新策略更改为 NONE。当通过类似 Reactive REST Client 中描述的配置提供 ReactiveElasticsearchTemplate 时，其默认刷新策略原本就已设置为 NONE。

items.source: The method <T> Publisher<T> execute(ClientCallback<Publisher<T>> callback) has been deprecated. As there now are multiple implementations using different client libraries the execute method is still available in the different implementations, but there is no more method in the interface, because there is no common callback interface for the different clients.
items.translation: <T> Publisher<T> execute(ClientCallback<Publisher<T>> callback) 方法已被弃用。 由于现在存在使用不同客户端库的多种实现，execute 方法仍可在各个具体实现中找到，但接口中已不再提供该方法，因为不同的客户端之间不存在通用的回调接口。

items.source: The new client forces applications to use the jakarta.json.spi.JsonProvider package whereas Spring Boot will stick to javax.json.spi.JsonProvider until version 3. So switching the default implementaiton in Spring Data Elasticsearch can only come with Spring Data Elasticsearch 5 (Spring Data 3, Spring 6).
items.translation: 新客户端强制应用程序使用 `jakarta.json.spi.JsonProvider` 包，而 Spring Boot 在版本 3 之前仍将沿用 `javax.json.spi.JsonProvider`。因此，切换 Spring Data Elasticsearch 中的默认实现只能等到 Spring Data Elasticsearch 5（即 Spring Data 3、Spring 6）发布时才能实现。
